note: The private half of tests/data/web_app_manifest_mutants.json (tools/mutate.py runs it together with the public half): the mutants of files that are not in the public repository, and the ones that only a test that is not there catches. Mutants of the installable web app (docs/INSTALL_AS_APP.md): the manifest's fields, the icons and their digits, the budgets, the two that would register a service worker, and the one exact nginx location of the manifest (its type, caching, headers and fallback; the pages' policy unchanged), for tools/mutate.py (docs/WORKFLOW.md, 'Mutation checks'). Run from the checkout: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/web_app_manifest_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1. The nginx mutants need the program nginx installed (tests/scripts/test_nginx_headers.py runs the real file and catches them by a real answer); the others are caught by tests/scripts/test_web_app_manifest.py.

mutants.new:
default_type application/manifest+json;
        add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, must-revalidate" always;
